var completeMixed = Execute(mixedRequest.ToJsonString(), "/mixed-execute");
await mixedExecution.ReservationEntered.Task.WaitAsync(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(10));

Check(!completeMixed.IsCompleted && mixedModel.Calls == 1 && protectedEffects == 0 && !mixedObservations.Any(item => item["stage"]!.GetValue<string>() is "Deserialize.Guard" or "Create.Guard" or "Run.Guard"), "A complete recovered mixed batch must reserve every genuine decision before any native preparation or provider/effect work.");
mixedExecution.ReservationRelease.TrySetResult();
Check(await completeMixed == 409 && mixedExecution.Reservations == 1 && mixedExecution.Ownerships == 2 && mixedModel.Calls == 1 && protectedEffects == 0, "A failed complete reservation cannot reach native preparation or effects.");
var normalizerRejected = false;
try { _ = NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(settlement.ToJsonString(), Key("thread"), catalog, new()); } catch (ArgumentException) { normalizerRejected = true; }
Check(normalizerRejected, "Ordinary canonical normalization must explicitly reject the reserved recovery envelope before any journal/provider callback.");
Console.WriteLine("Native browser recovery admission passed.");
async Task<int> Execute(string raw, string route = "/execute")
{
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, route) { Content = new StringContent(raw, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json") };
    request.Headers.Add("X-Authenticated", "fixture");
    using var response = await http.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead);
    using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(); using var bytes = new MemoryStream();
    try { await stream.CopyToAsync(bytes); }
    catch (IOException exception) { throw new Exception("Native fixture stream failed: " + Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes.ToArray()) + "\nObservations: " + JsonSerializer.Serialize(observations), exception); }
    return (int)response.StatusCode;
}
async Task<int> Run(string raw)
{
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/run") { Content = new StringContent(raw, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json") };
    request.Headers.Add("X-Authenticated", "fixture");
    using var response = await http.SendAsync(request);
    return (int)response.StatusCode;
}
async Task<(int Status, JsonNode? Body)> Send(string route, string[]? versions)
{
    using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, "/" + route + "/thread") { Content = new StringContent(configuration, Encoding.UTF8, "application/json") };
    request.Headers.Add("X-Authenticated", "fixture");
    if (versions is not null) request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Hashbrown-Recovery-Version", versions);
    using var response = await http.SendAsync(request);
    Check(response.Headers.CacheControl?.NoStore == true, "Every recovery response must remain no-store.");
    var text = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();
    return ((int)response.StatusCode, string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? null : JsonNode.Parse(text));
}
public class RecoveryJournal : DispatchProxy
{
    public NativeSessionStatus Status { get; set; } = new(410);
    public int Acquisitions { get; private set; }
    public int OrdinaryAcquisitions { get; private set; }
    public int RecoveryAcquisitions { get; private set; }
    public string? LastRaw { get; private set; }
    protected override object? Invoke(MethodInfo? method, object?[]? args)
    {
        if (method!.Name == "ReadStatusAsync") return ValueTask.FromResult(Status);
        Acquisitions++;
        if (method.Name is "TryAcquireAsync" or "TryAcquireBrowserRecoveryAsync")
        {
            if (method.Name == "TryAcquireAsync") OrdinaryAcquisitions++; else RecoveryAcquisitions++;
            LastRaw = (string)args![1]!;
            return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(409));
        }
        throw new Exception("Read-only route reached journal authority: " + method.Name);
    }
}
sealed class FixtureAuthentication(IOptionsMonitor<AuthenticationSchemeOptions> options, ILoggerFactory logger, UrlEncoder encoder) : AuthenticationHandler<AuthenticationSchemeOptions>(options, logger, encoder)
{
    protected override Task<AuthenticateResult> HandleAuthenticateAsync() => Task.FromResult(Request.Headers["X-Authenticated"] != "fixture" ? AuthenticateResult.NoResult() : AuthenticateResult.Success(new AuthenticationTicket(new ClaimsPrincipal(new ClaimsIdentity([new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, "owned")], "fixture")), "fixture")));
}

sealed class RefusingModel : IChatClient
{
    public int Calls { get; private set; }
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken ct = default) { Calls++; throw new Exception("Unexpected provider preparation."); }
    public IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken ct = default) { Calls++; throw new Exception("Unexpected provider preparation."); }
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}

public class ExecutingJournal : DispatchProxy
{
    public NativeSessionSnapshot? Saved { get; private set; }
    public int Ordinary { get; private set; }
    public int Recovery { get; private set; }
    public int Ownerships { get; private set; }
    public string? LastRaw { get; private set; }
    public string? SubmittedPublicRequest { get; private set; }
    public NativeToolCatalog Catalog { get; set; } = new([]);
    public bool BlockReservation { get; set; }
    public int Reservations { get; private set; }
    public TaskCompletionSource ReservationEntered { get; private set; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    public TaskCompletionSource ReservationRelease { get; private set; } = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
    private NativeSessionKey? _key;
    private NativeSessionLease? _lease;
    public void Reset() { Saved = null; Ordinary = 0; Recovery = 0; Ownerships = 0; Reservations = 0; BlockReservation = false; ReservationEntered = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously); ReservationRelease = new(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously); LastRaw = null; SubmittedPublicRequest = null; _key = null; _lease = null; }
    protected override object? Invoke(MethodInfo? method, object?[]? args)
    {
        if (method!.Name is "TryAcquireAsync" or "TryAcquireBrowserRecoveryAsync")
        {
            var key = (NativeSessionKey)args![0]!; var raw = (string)args[1]!; LastRaw = raw;
            JsonObject current;
            try
            {
                using var original = JsonDocument.Parse(raw, new JsonDocumentOptions { MaxDepth = 64 });
                ValidateOriginal(original.RootElement);
                if (method.Name == "TryAcquireBrowserRecoveryAsync") ValidateRecoveryWire(original.RootElement);
                if (Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(raw) > 8192) return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(400));
                current = JsonNode.Parse(raw)!.AsObject();
            }
            catch (Exception exception) when (exception is ArgumentException or JsonException or InvalidOperationException or KeyNotFoundException) { return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(400)); }
            if (method.Name == "TryAcquireBrowserRecoveryAsync")
            {
                Recovery++;
                var typed = (NativeBrowserRecoveryRequest)args[2]!;
                var wire = current["forwardedProps"]!["hashbrown"]!["recovery"]!.AsObject();
                if (wire.Count != 3 || wire["version"]!.GetValue<int>() != typed.ProtocolVersion || wire["serverRevision"]!.GetValue<long>() != typed.ServerRevision || typed.ServerRevision != 7 || Saved is null || key.Id != _key!.Id || typed.Outcomes.Count != Saved.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.Count || !Saved.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal).SetEquals(typed.Outcomes.Select(item => item.ToolCallId)) || typed.Outcomes.Any(item => item.Status != "result") || wire["outcomes"]!.AsArray().Count != typed.Outcomes.Count || wire["outcomes"]!.AsArray().Select((item, index) => item!["toolCallId"]!.GetValue<string>() != typed.Outcomes[index].ToolCallId || item["status"]!.GetValue<string>() != typed.Outcomes[index].Status).Any(item => item)) return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(409));
                var expected = Saved.Approvals.PendingBatch?.Batch.ProtectedRequests.Select(item => item.RequestId).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal) ?? [];
                var decisions = current["resume"] as JsonArray;
                if ((decisions?.Count ?? 0) != expected.Count || decisions is not null && !expected.SetEquals(decisions.Select(item => item!["interruptId"]!.GetValue<string>()))) return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(409));
                var stored = JsonNode.Parse(Saved.PublicRequest)!.AsObject();
                var forwarded = current["forwardedProps"]!.AsObject(); var extension = forwarded["hashbrown"]!.AsObject(); extension.Remove("recovery");
                if (extension.Count == 0 && stored["forwardedProps"]?["hashbrown"] is null) forwarded.Remove("hashbrown");
                if (forwarded.Count == 0 && !stored.ContainsKey("forwardedProps")) current.Remove("forwardedProps");
                current.Remove("resume");
            }
            else Ordinary++;
            var canonical = NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(current.ToJsonString(), key, Catalog, new());
            var storedCanonical = Saved is null ? null : new NativeSessionSnapshot(Saved.NativeJson, NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(Saved.PublicRequest, key, Catalog, new()), Saved.PendingCalls, Saved.ExpectedBrowserCallIds, Saved.TurnCompleted, Saved.Approvals);
            var admits = method.Name == "TryAcquireBrowserRecoveryAsync"
                ? storedCanonical is not null && AdmitsStrictRecovery(canonical, storedCanonical)
                : NativeSessionHistory.Admits(canonical, storedCanonical);
            if (!admits) return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(409));
            _key = key; Ownerships++; _lease = new(key, "owned-" + Ownerships, Ownerships, Ownerships == 1 ? 6 : 8);
            return ValueTask.FromResult(new NativeSessionAdmission(200, _lease, Saved, Saved is null));
        }
        if (method.Name == "SaveAsync")
        {
            var value = (NativeSessionSave)args![1]!;
            SubmittedPublicRequest = value.PublicRequest;
            // Match production PostgresNativeSessionJournal.SaveAsync's public canonical boundary.
            var canonical = NativeSessionHistory.Normalize(value.PublicRequest, _key!, Catalog, new());
            Saved = new(value.NativeJson, canonical, value.PendingCalls, value.ExpectedBrowserCallIds, value.TurnCompleted, value.Approvals);
            return ValueTask.FromResult<NativeSavedReceipt?>(new(_lease!, 7));
        }
        if (method.Name is "RenewAsync" or "AuthorizePublicationAsync" or "FinalizePublicationAsync" or "FailureCleanupAsync") return ValueTask.FromResult(true);
        if (method.Name == "CaptureModelCallAsync" || method.Name == "CaptureApprovalBatchAsync") return ValueTask.FromResult(true);
        if (method.Name == "GetOwnedApprovalEvidenceAsync")
        {
            if (Saved?.Approvals.PendingBatch is not { } batch) throw new Exception("Browser-only recovery must never invent a protected approval batch.");
            return ValueTask.FromResult<NativeApprovalEvidence?>(new(_key!.Id, "fixture", Catalog.Identity, _lease!, batch, 7, NativeApprovalState.Pending, [], null, null, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(10)));
        }
        if (method.Name == "TryAdmitApprovalBatchAsync")
        {
            if (!BlockReservation) throw new Exception("Complete mixed reservation requires its explicit gate.");
            Reservations++; ReservationEntered.TrySetResult();
            return RefuseAfterGate();
        }
        throw new Exception("Unexpected journal method in isolated browser boundary: " + method.Name);
    }
    private static bool AdmitsStrictRecovery(string canonical, NativeSessionSnapshot stored)
    {
        var incoming = JsonNode.Parse(canonical)!.AsObject();
        var original = JsonNode.Parse(stored.PublicRequest)!.AsObject();
        var messages = incoming["messages"]!.AsArray(); var prefix = original["messages"]!.AsArray();
        var expected = stored.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        if (expected.Count == 0 || expected.Count != stored.ExpectedBrowserCallIds.Count || messages.Count != prefix.Count + expected.Count) return false;
        if (prefix.Where((message, index) => !JsonNode.DeepEquals(message, messages[index])).Any()) return false;
        var ordered = prefix.OfType<JsonObject>().SelectMany(message => message["toolCalls"] is JsonArray calls ? calls.OfType<JsonObject>() : []).Select(call => call["id"]!.GetValue<string>()).Where(expected.Contains).ToArray();
        if (ordered.Length != expected.Count || !expected.SetEquals(ordered) || prefix.Any(message => message?["role"]?.GetValue<string>() == "tool" && expected.Contains(message["toolCallId"]!.GetValue<string>()))) return false;
        var ids = prefix.Select(message => message!["id"]!.GetValue<string>()).ToHashSet(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        for (var index = 0; index < ordered.Length; index++)
        {
            var result = messages[prefix.Count + index];
            if (result?["role"]?.GetValue<string>() != "tool" || result["toolCallId"]?.GetValue<string>() != ordered[index] || result["id"] is not JsonValue id || !id.TryGetValue<string>(out var fresh) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fresh) || !ids.Add(fresh)) return false;
        }
        incoming.Remove("messages"); original.Remove("messages");
        return JsonNode.DeepEquals(incoming, original);
    }
    private async ValueTask<bool> RefuseAfterGate() { await ReservationRelease.Task; return false; }
    private static void ValidateRecoveryWire(JsonElement root)
    {
        var forwarded = root.GetProperty("forwardedProps");
        var hashbrown = forwarded.GetProperty("hashbrown");
        if (forwarded.EnumerateObject().Any(item => item.Name != "hashbrown" && string.Equals(item.Name, "hashbrown", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) || hashbrown.EnumerateObject().Any(item => item.Name != "recovery" && string.Equals(item.Name, "recovery", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))) throw new ArgumentException("Ambiguous original recovery alias.");
        var recovery = hashbrown.GetProperty("recovery");
        if (recovery.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || recovery.EnumerateObject().Count() != 3 || recovery.EnumerateObject().Any(item => item.Name is not ("version" or "serverRevision" or "outcomes"))) throw new ArgumentException("Unknown original recovery fields.");
        foreach (var outcome in recovery.GetProperty("outcomes").EnumerateArray())
            if (outcome.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || outcome.EnumerateObject().Count() != 2 || outcome.EnumerateObject().Any(item => item.Name is not ("toolCallId" or "status"))) throw new ArgumentException("Unknown original outcome fields.");
    }
    private static void ValidateOriginal(JsonElement value)
    {
        if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object)
        {
            var names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var property in value.EnumerateObject())
            {
                if (!names.Add(property.Name)) throw new ArgumentException("Duplicate original property.");
                ValidateOriginal(property.Value);
            }
        }
        else if (value.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Array) foreach (var item in value.EnumerateArray()) ValidateOriginal(item);
    }
}
sealed class BoundaryModel : IChatClient
{
    public int Calls { get; private set; }
    public bool SecondBrowser { get; init; }
    public bool TrailingText { get; init; }
    public bool Mixed { get; init; }
    private JsonNode? _expected;
    public void Reset(JsonNode? expected) { Calls = 0; _expected = expected?.DeepClone(); }
    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        if (options is null || !options.TryGetRunAgentInput(out var actual)) throw new Exception("Provider must observe actual typed transport options.");
        var serialized = JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(actual, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput)!;
        if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(serialized["forwardedProps"], _expected) || serialized["forwardedProps"]?["hashbrown"]?["recovery"] is not null) throw new Exception("Provider options must adopt trusted sanitized container shape.");
        Calls++;
        if (Calls != 1) return Task.FromResult(new ChatResponse(new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, "{}") { MessageId = "done-" + Calls }) { ResponseId = "done-" + Calls });
        var contents = new List<AIContent> { new FunctionCallContent("browser", "frontend", new Dictionary<string, object?>()) };
        if (SecondBrowser) contents.Add(new FunctionCallContent("browser-2", "frontend", new Dictionary<string, object?>()));
        if (Mixed) { contents.Add(new FunctionCallContent("protected-1", "backend", new Dictionary<string, object?>())); contents.Add(new FunctionCallContent("protected-2", "backend", new Dictionary<string, object?>())); }
        var response = new List<ChatMessage> { new(ChatRole.Assistant, contents) { MessageId = "browser-parent" } };
        if (TrailingText) response.Add(new(ChatRole.Assistant, "text after announcement") { MessageId = "after-announcement" });
        return Task.FromResult(new ChatResponse(response) { ResponseId = "browser-parent", FinishReason = ChatFinishReason.ToolCalls });
    }
    public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options = null, [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var response = await GetResponseAsync(messages, options, cancellationToken);
        if (Calls == 1 && TrailingText)
        {
            // Each content update has its own genuine identity; finish metadata is a separate final update.
            foreach (var message in response.Messages)
            {
                if (message.Contents.All(content => content is FunctionCallContent))
                {
                    foreach (var call in message.Contents.Cast<FunctionCallContent>())
                    {
                        var declaration = new ChatMessage(ChatRole.Assistant, [call]) { MessageId = "parent-" + call.CallId };
                        foreach (var update in new ChatResponse(declaration) { ResponseId = declaration.MessageId, FinishReason = ChatFinishReason.ToolCalls }.ToChatResponseUpdates()) yield return update;
                    }
                }
                else foreach (var update in new ChatResponse(message) { ResponseId = message.MessageId }.ToChatResponseUpdates()) yield return update;
            }
            yield return new ChatResponseUpdate { ResponseId = "browser-parent", FinishReason = ChatFinishReason.ToolCalls };
        }
        else foreach (var update in response.ToChatResponseUpdates()) yield return update;
    }
    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null) => null;
    public void Dispose() { }
}

sealed class ControlledBindingConverter : JsonConverter<RunAgentInput>
{
    public string? Original { get; private set; }
    public bool Changed { get; private set; }
    public override RunAgentInput Read(ref Utf8JsonReader reader, Type typeToConvert, JsonSerializerOptions options)
    {
        using var document = JsonDocument.ParseValue(ref reader);
        var raw = document.RootElement.GetRawText();
        var input = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(raw, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput)!;
        if (!input.RunId.StartsWith("binding-", StringComparison.Ordinal)) return input;
        Original = raw; Changed = input.RunId != "binding-equal";
        if (input.RunId is "binding-recovery" or "binding-sibling")
        {
            var forwarded = JsonNode.Parse(input.ForwardedProperties!.Value.GetRawText())!;
            if (input.RunId == "binding-recovery") forwarded["hashbrown"]!["recovery"]!["serverRevision"] = 8;
            else forwarded["application"]!["approved"] = false;
            input.ForwardedProperties = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(forwarded);
        }
        else if (input.RunId == "binding-state") input.State = JsonSerializer.SerializeToElement(new { nested = new { value = "changed" } });
        return input;
    }
    public override void Write(Utf8JsonWriter writer, RunAgentInput value, JsonSerializerOptions options) => JsonSerializer.Serialize(writer, value, AGUIJsonSerializerContext.Default.RunAgentInput);
}
